Forwarding Sofia's note with a few questions from SecOps. TL;DR: we can deliver the SIEM snapshot but need to confirm scope, retention extraction method, and whether Acme needs raw logs or parsed alerts.

Questions from SecOps (to confirm before we lock windows):
- Snapshot content: do you want full raw log bundles (compressed), or filtered export (authN/authZ events, system events, API gateway logs)?
- Retention period: you asked for Apr 1 — Jun 30; do you need continuous coverage (e.g., daily snapshots) or a single-representative snapshot and sampling plan?
- Access model: will Acme request direct read-only access to our SIEM/alerts console for live review (we need a formal access agreement) or will we provide exports only?

I'll plan for an Aug 6 delivery for the filtered export unless you specify otherwise.
